fields.description: A limbo bar for solid objects. Every round, the player in last place turns a hooded knob in secret, dropping a loose bar by 1, 2, or 3 mm, and then everyone commits a block from their own stock at the same instant, blind. Cups lift together; the tallest block that slides through without touching the bar wins the round and joins your score line, and a block that touches is gone for good. Nothing is marked and nothing is written down mid-round, the bar itself is the only judge. 2-4 players, 20 min, ages 14+. The complete rules ship with the files as RULES.md. By Bob.
fields.prompt: 3D printed tabletop game Clearance: a printed gantry with a hooded threaded knob column, a loose bar resting in a clear lane, four player stock rails of unmarked square blocks in graduated heights, and four opaque commit cups, matte PLA parts on a wood table, studio product photography, 3/4 hero angle
